name: continue
description: Drive the current task to a verified result instead of stopping at a plausible report. Use when the user says /continue, keep going, not done yet, push further, or is unhappy with the result. Rebuilds requirements from the conversation, re-checks real state, fixes root causes, verifies from the consumer side, offloads side quests.
